card.name: Galaxy and aging-star descriptions in astronomy news
card.fires_on: Words in astronomy press-release text about galaxies and aging stars, such as 'older' or 'old' before 'stars', or the commas and small words next to them. Also fires on credit lines naming Hubble image teams.
